problem_statement: Indie founders and small startup teams understand a user problem intellectually but still build the wrong solution due to inadequate continuous customer feedback loops during development, costing months of wasted work and money.
target_segment: Solo founders and small startup teams (1–5 people) building B2B or B2C SaaS products
notes: Standalone signal from a personal founder post-mortem. Weaker on its own but reinforces the AI MVP scoping cluster above. The pain is real (months of wasted effort) but buyer willingness-to-pay for a tool is not explicit here. Kept separate because the solution space differs — this points to ongoing validation tooling rather than pre-build scoping.
